displayRotation.description: Display-only rotation of the live image, in degrees; recorded data is not rotated.

displayFlipX.description: Display-only horizontal mirror of the live image.

displayFlipY.description: Display-only vertical mirror of the live image.

displayTransform.description: The same three settings as one dict: {"rotation": 90, "flipX": false, "flipY": true}. Takes precedence over the flat keys.
